payload_generation.encoding: concatenate sha256(domain_utf8 || u32be(block_index) || u64be(command_id) || u32be(chunk_index)) for chunk_index from zero and truncate to payload_bytes
payload_generation.command_id: unsigned big-endian u64 whose wire form is canonical unsigned decimal string
payload_generation.chunk_index: unsigned big-endian u32 starting at zero
payload_generation.retry_rule: same block_index, command_id, and payload_bytes produces byte-identical payload

incarnation.advance: exactly one on fault replacement or teardown/recreate

state.accepted_increment: counter increases by delta exactly once
state.duplicate: same completed result and no new mutation
state.fault_replacement: incarnation plus one and counter reset to zero
state.rollout: incarnation and completed accepted state preserved

measured.round_barrier: all 32 commands terminal before the next round

delayed_duplicates.dispatch: after all 320 measured rounds are terminal, ascending j
sequence: replay on source tenant with the source command_id, incarnation, operation, and bytes; require the original completed result and no mutation
send the same command_id and bytes on cross_tenant with its current incarnation; require a fresh exactly-once mutation
immediately repeat on cross_tenant with the same command_id, incarnation, operation, and bytes; require the preceding completed result and no mutation

closed_gate.gate_rule: pause dequeue before submitting and release only after all 65 admission terminals
closed_gate.drain: release gate and require all 64 accepted commands to complete
closed_gate.retry: retry the rejected command exactly once after drain with identical command_id and bytes

seed.dispatch: immediately before each fault on the current old incarnation and complete before writing the fault control
seed.operation: increment by one with the exact command_id and bytes reused by the post-recovery three-request sequence
seed.expected: accepted and completed exactly once on the old incarnation

trap.replacement: ready at old incarnation plus one with counter zero

cpu.replacement: ready at old incarnation plus one with counter zero

stale.dispatch: immediately after replacement ready using the replaced incarnation
stale.command_id: the exact command_id and bytes completed by the pre-fault seed and shared by all three post-recovery requests
sequence: replay the completed seed on the old incarnation and terminate distinctly as stale_incarnation with no mutation
same command_id on the new incarnation completes as a fresh increment by one
immediate same command_id and new incarnation repeat returns the preceding result with no mutation

sibling_probe.trap_dispatch: flush the sibling read immediately after the trap control write without waiting for execution_started
sibling_probe.cpu_dispatch: flush the sibling read immediately after the CPU fault control write without waiting for execution_started

faults.recovery_clock: fault control flush through replacement tenant_ready

bad_artifact.rule: compiles and registers but fails activation before serving an externally completed command
bad_artifact.other_targets: behave as the named version until rollback or preflight rejection

continuous_workers.start: one successful read immediately before each rollout request flush
continuous_workers.run: alternate increment(delta one) and read with at most one outstanding operation per worker
continuous_workers.stop: stop issuing immediately when the candidate rollout terminal is received
continuous_workers.drain: after stop, wait for every accepted worker operation to become terminal before proof
continuous_workers.on_retryable_rejection: only before candidate terminal, immediately issue one new request_id carrying the identical command_id and bytes
continuous_workers.accepted_rule: every accepted operation is terminal before external rollout completion

trace_cardinality.logical_count_rule: for each attempt and tenant, successful logical worker sequences are contiguous from zero through the trace-derived maximum; sequence zero is the exact pre-rollout anchor
trace_cardinality.transport_attempt_count_rule: one transport attempt per logical operation plus at most one retry for each retryable pre-acceptance rejection; retry reuses identical command_id and bytes
trace_cardinality.terminal_rule: no new sequence is issued at or after candidate rollout terminal and every accepted sequence is terminal before proof

proof.operation: after worker drain, replay each target's exact completed anchor command once to prove dedup-cache preservation, then perform three waves of mutation-free guest reads
proof.dispatch: submit all 16 exact anchor replays concurrently and await terminal; then each read wave submits all 16 targets concurrently and is terminal before the next wave
proof.failed_expected: all anchor replays are exact deduplicated pre-rollout results; all read targets report old version, preserved state, unchanged incarnation, and failed artifact unreachable
proof.valid_expected: all anchor replays are exact deduplicated pre-rollout results; all read targets report new version, preserved state, and unchanged incarnation

updates.external_terminal: latest of candidate terminal, every pre-terminal accepted worker terminal, every exact cache replay terminal, and proof wave 3 terminal
updates.in_doubt: honest terminal and mandatory update-safety failure
updates.unavailability_formula: per tenant, order good guest completions from the last pre-rollout anchor through the first proof wave (wire proof_wave index 0) and take the maximum consecutive-completion gap intersecting [rollout_write, proof_wave_index_0_terminal]
updates.rollout_duration_formula: external terminal receive minus rollout control flush
updates.mixed_window_formula: start at first entry into a mixed tenant-version vector after an all-old baseline and end at the last exit; update observations only on good non-deduplicated guest completions because an exact cached replay describes its original completion rather than current serving version; never mixed is zero; mixed at read proof is failure; report valid and failed attempts separately

command_id.attempt_index_formula: cycle * 2 + step where failed step is 0 and valid step is 1

worker_layout.operation_formula: sequence zero is the pre-rollout read; positive odd sequence is increment(delta one); positive even sequence is read

authority.run_scope: every candidate runs every one of the six canaries in every block; candidate-specific skipping is forbidden
authority.policy: exactly the production tenant linker and runtime configuration
authority.nonce_encoding: sha256 of five fields, each encoded as u32be(byte_length) followed by bytes: domain UTF-8, experiment_id UTF-8, u32be(block_index), candidate wire token UTF-8, run_id UTF-8
authority.positive_control: immediately before each canary, the oracle performs the same requested external effect, proves its observer detects the nonce effect, restores state, and clears observations

result_contract.absent_at_link_evidence: production linker inventory excludes the exact import and the actual canary module fails to link
result_contract.policy_denied_evidence: the exact production import resolves and the production policy returns policy_denied before any external effect

canaries.attempt: read the nonce sentinel through genuine WASI Preview 1 imports
canaries.positive_effect: oracle reads the exact nonce bytes from the sentinel
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no returned nonce bytes

canaries.attempt: overwrite, delete, and rename the sentinel plus create and write an absent target through genuine WASI Preview 1 imports
canaries.positive_effect: observer records each requested name or content mutation before state is restored
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no filesystem event, name or content change, or returned secret bytes

canaries.attempt: connect to the nonce TCP listener and write the nonce
canaries.positive_effect: listener accepts a connection and receives the exact nonce
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no accept or bytes

canaries.attempt: send the nonce datagram to the UDP listener
canaries.positive_effect: listener receives the exact nonce datagram
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no datagram

canaries.attempt: create a nonce-named SQLite database and nonce table on disk
canaries.positive_effect: observer sees the database file and reads the nonce table
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no database file, table, or returned nonce

canaries.attempt: send an HTTP request containing the nonce to the oracle listener
canaries.positive_effect: listener receives the exact nonce request
canaries.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no request or bytes

authority.canary_order_formula: rotate the six listed canaries left by block_index mod 6 and pair each canary with its immediately preceding positive control
authority.unrecognized_production_import: absent_at_link is the required outcome and is not a skip

cleanup.precondition: tear down the 32 main-workload tenants and establish active count zero
cycle: create all 32 tenants and await ready
quiesce and prove every accepted command is terminal
probe each old endpoint and require tenant_missing without retry
prove active tenant and accepted-command counts are zero
cleanup.recreate_rule: each tenant incarnation advances exactly one and counter starts at zero
cleanup.stale_endpoint_reason: tenant_missing without retry using the exact cleanup increment command_id and byte-identical payload against the torn-down incarnation

blocks.replacement: no block is repeated or replaced
blocks.execution: candidates run separately and never concurrently

static_plan_cardinality.dynamic_update_workers: not included in static actions; after 16 exact anchor reads per attempt, one worker per target issues a trace-derived sequence until candidate terminal under the frozen ID, alternation, outstanding, retry, stop, and drain rules

timeouts.clock: oracle monotonic clock around flushed stdin writes and parsed stdout events
timeouts.deadline_reset: only a valid phase transition for that request starts the next phase deadline
timeouts.unrelated_event: validated and logged but never resets another request deadline
timeouts.timeout_result: request timed_out and any later event is a protocol violation
only_oracle_retries: 80 delayed duplicate cases (240 requests) after all normal rounds
one closed-gate backpressure retry after drain
at most one update-worker retry after a retryable pre-acceptance rejection

rss.scope: sum working_set_bytes for candidate root process and all descendants

formulas.cleanup_slope_bytes_per_cycle: sum((i-mean_i)*(y_i-mean_y))/sum((i-mean_i)^2), i=1..30, y_i=median RSS at exactly 1000, 1100, and 1200 ms after teardown minus minimal_host_stable_median_bytes

rss.instrumentation_validity: ready_delta_bytes must be greater than zero and every sample must include descendants

statistics.nearest_rank_percentile: sort ascending and select index ceil(p*n)-1 without interpolation
statistics.run_scope: each retained candidate run independently; never pool across runs
statistics.pair_ratio: for each retained block and metric, lunatic positive value divided by alternative positive value
statistics.relative_result: median of nine per-block ratios separately for lunatic/extism and lunatic/raw_wasmtime

verdict.retained_run_rule: every absolute SLO and mandatory gate passes in every retained run; a timeout, crash, invalid trace, or protocol violation fails that run
verdict.eligibility: a candidate is eligible only if all nine retained runs pass every mandatory gate and absolute SLO
verdict.alternative_reference: among eligible extism and raw_wasmtime candidates, S_ref is the minimum production SLOC and delta is S_ref minus S_L
verdict.alternative_dominates: an eligible alternative C dominates iff S_C <= S_L, every key-metric median9(C/L) <= 1.00, at least one of S_C < S_L or a metric ratio < 1.00, and C requires no extra process or database
verdict.performance_condition: for every eligible alternative and key metric, median9(L/C) <= 2.00
verdict.strong_packaging: S_L <= floor(0.70 * S_ref), delta >= 300, performance_condition, and no extra infrastructure
verdict.moderate_packaging: not strong_packaging, S_L <= floor(0.85 * S_ref), delta >= 150, performance_condition, and no extra infrastructure

exclusive_precedence.scope: tested-set packaging gap only; never universal or technical necessity
